changelog: Fix: repairs 95 orphaned trade_variables answers (19 trades) caused by a delete-then-reinsert bug in the strategy variable editor
New: foreign keys on trade_variables (variable_id RESTRICT, trade_id CASCADE) so the orphaning bug cannot recur
New: strategy_variables gains role (gate/tag), timeframe, criteria, is_active, created_at — the pass/fail checklist model
Fix: strategy variable editing is now non-destructive — existing ids are updated in place, never deleted out from under recorded answers; deactivate replaces delete for variables with history
Change: pre-trade checklist now renders from the active strategy's gate variables instead of a hardcoded FSA rule set
Delivered via the migrate.php runner shipped in v3.7.0 — export the database before running these migrations on live
